title: Mystical Mask Shop
description: A vibrant green wooden storefront window displays a large green-skinned female figure with closed eyes, adorned with an elaborate headdress of red lotus flowers, golden spirals, and numerous colorful theatrical masks. In front of her sits a large green bowl overflowing with blueberries, surrounded by glowing lanterns, an open book, and hanging decorations against a dark nighttime cobblestone street.
prompt: A surreal nighttime scene of a mystical shop window with deep emerald green wooden frame. Inside, a green-skinned female figure with closed eyes emerges from a giant red lotus flower headdress decorated with golden spirals and many colorful Venetian and theatrical masks. A large green bowl filled with blueberries sits in front, with glowing lanterns, an open ancient book, and hanging ornaments. Dark cobblestone street visible outside, rich vibrant colors with intricate patterns and magical atmosphere.
